page_title: WOL 3-0 WHU | Wolves v West Ham 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) heads on.
90+3' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Jose Sa has no trouble gathering it.
90+3' Ezra Mayers (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 29874.
90+2' Peter Bankes interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jhon Arias (Wolves). A free kick has been awarded to West Ham.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
88' Here is a change. Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare is going off and Rob Edwards gives the last tactical orders to David Moller Wolfe (Wolves).

87' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matheus Mane leaves the pitch and Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) comes on.
85' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Peter Bankes didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
82' The free kick is taken by Oliver Scarles (West Ham), but ball is cleared.
80' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
80' Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
80' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
79' Jhon Arias (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolves.

77' Matheus Mane (Wolves) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola made an astonishing save!
75' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
73' Jose Sa comes off his line to intercept the corner from Oliver Scarles (West Ham).
73' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
72' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.

72' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Peter Bankes saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to West Ham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
66' The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
66' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.

65' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
65' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

64' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alphonse Areola sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) coming on for Hee-Chan Hwang.

59' A rebound falls at the feet of Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
59' The resulting corner from Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
58' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. West Ham get a corner.

56' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
55' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
54' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
51' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 35:65.
48' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
47' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' Substitution. Joao Gomes makes his way off the pitch and Andre (Wolves) comes on as his replacement.
46' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) replaces Freddie Potts.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Soungoutou Magassa will be replaced by Ezra Mayers (West Ham).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is alert and denies him.
45+5' A cross from Matheus Mane (Wolves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

45+4' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
45+2' The game is interrupted. Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

41' 3 - 0 Goal! Hugo Bueno puts Matheus Mane (Wolves) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
38' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the corner but it's cleared.

38' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alphonse Areola, who pulls off a comfortable save! Wolves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
37' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves). Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
31' 2 - 0 Goal! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Alphonse Areola.
30' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
30' Referee Peter Bankes is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Wolves!
30' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Wolves as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
29' Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Wolves are awarded a penalty kick!
26' Jhon Arias (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Peter Bankes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
24' Joao Gomes (Wolves) brings an opponent down and Peter Bankes interrupts the game.
22' Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
20' Joao Gomes (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

16' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment. Santiago Bueno (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
14' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Oliver Scarles (West Ham) took the corner.

13' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and West Ham will take a corner.
11' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
9' Flag up against Oliver Scarles (West Ham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
6' An attempted cross from Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) is cleared.
4' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Hee-Chan Hwang sprays a pass out to Jhon Arias (Wolves), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
3' Matheus Mane (Wolves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
2' Freddie Potts (West Ham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
